ink.$description: Ink — Primary text, body copy, heading text — near-black with a faint cool cast, never pure #000, keeping the page from feeling harsh

paper.$description: Paper — Card surfaces, elevated product mockups, input fields — pure white against the cooler canvas reads as lifted, not flat

mist.$description: Mist — Page canvas, full-width background bands — a cool-tinted off-white that feels softer than pure white but still reads as light

fog.$description: Fog — Secondary body text, helper copy, muted descriptions — the most-used neutral after Ink, creates the dominant mid-tone of the page

ash.$description: Ash — Tertiary text, icon strokes, decorative dividers — a cool gray that still carries enough chroma to read as designed, not default

smoke.$description: Smoke — Deep body text alternative, emphasized inline text — sits between Ink and Fog for mid-emphasis passages

silver.$description: Silver — Disabled or de-emphasized text, tertiary metadata

pebble.$description: Pebble — Muted link text, breadcrumb-style secondary navigation

hairline.$description: Hairline — Input borders, subtle dividers, card edges — cool and barely-there, defines boundaries without darkening the surface

signal-blue.$description: Signal Blue — Blue supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

sky-blue.$description: Sky Blue — Secondary blue for heading accents, lighter link states, decorative icon highlights — a softer companion to Signal Blue used when the primary blue would feel too loud

ui-sans-serif-system-stack-apple-system-.$description: All UI and editorial text. The system stack is deliberate — on Apple devices this resolves to SF Pro, matching the Things app itself. Weight 600-800 carries headings; weight 400 carries body. No custom or web-loaded font; the restraint IS the brand.
